name: Spillway
author: Trance
description: Light pours out of the middle and over every edge. White lines that keep the brighter of themselves and what is under them ride a strong outward current, and their brightness is colored in bands, so the whole screen runs in contours. The bass pushes the flood, the leads twist it.
pixel:
rot = rot + 0.012*sin(rad*5 - time*0.7)
zoom = zoom + 0.01*cos(ang*3 + tw)
